ValidationRule.description: This validation rule is created as part of CR-027. Only Users with DA/DM role can update Parent Lead lookup
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND($UserRole.Name != 'District Manager', $UserRole.Name != 'District Administrator', $UserRole.Name != 'Inbound Manager', $UserRole.Name != 'Inbound Rep', ISCHANGED( NSP_Parent_Lead__c), $Profile.Name <> "System Administrator", $Profile.Name <> "Data Migration" )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Only Users with District Administrator, District Manager, Inbound Manager or Inbound Rep Role can update Parent Lead
